evidence.decision: Orders meaningful first play, playable teaching, default platform input and inclusive cues; preserves the documented 44 pt touch-size conflict conservatively.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a revised first-play sequence and per-platform action/display contract or implementation within the game engine and identity.
evidence.transformation: Puzzle port ships a playable world, teaches tile manipulation in context and supports touch/undo instead of waiting for all downloads and requiring a controller.
evidence.verification: Fails unnecessary play gates, incomplete advertised-platform input and essential single-sense cues; measured downloads and controller tests are not invented.
evidence.applicability: Retains watchOS controller exception, supported orientations and safe-area/readability constraints; social/progress/purchase services remain conditional.
evidence.handoffs: Routes actual control mapping, player accommodations and selected social play to Game controls, Accessibility and Game Center.
evidence.distinctiveness: First-install playability, platform action mapping and meaningful cue redundancy drive real game-production changes.
